description: Check whether a specific subdomain is available on a given domain for a paid rental. Returns true if the subdomain can be rented. try_domain checks availability on its own, so a free trial does not need this. Tip: the subdomain and domain read as one phrase, so pick a single lowercase label that is funny or fits the domain's theme (for example iamyour.slopmommy.com or analien.lostmyluggage.com). A delightful combination is the point of a Popdot AI address.

domainId.description: The parent domain: its id from search_domains, or its name (for example addedtocart.shop)

subdomain.description: The subdomain label to check (e.g., 'myproject' for myproject.example.com)

name: check_availability
